gen-fs-kalam-fs-plein: A cozy, hand-drawn look with tightly bundled lines. Kalam is best at cozy warmth when the text is brief, while Plein, a plain sans with a clear channel into each round letter, does the reliable reading.
gen-fs-kalam-fs-recia: Recia brings sharp, authoritative letters with a light modulation you notice only up close. Recia's openings stay generous at every weight, and next to Kalam's cozy hand-drawn lines that is the quality worth noticing, in modest helpings.
gen-fs-kalam-fs-spline-sans: Inviting Kalam sets a cozy, hand-bundled tone up top. Spline Sans keeps wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs of it go down easily, though it is happiest when text stays modest.
gen-fs-kalam-fs-synonym: Cozy and tightly bundled, Kalam looks drawn by hand. Synonym sits beside it clean and dependable, a constant stripe of ink that makes the warmth feel grounded, ideal for a few lines.
gen-fs-kalam-outfit: Outfit bends its curves like cable, finishing each one well before it closes. Outfit handles approachable, single-width text best, while Kalam does cozy handwritten welcome best, and both are built for quick reads.
gen-fs-kalam-plus-jakarta-sans: A cozy, hand-drawn look with tightly bundled lines. Plus Jakarta Sans, a plain sans, is precise and monoline with curve endings kept apart, so beside Kalam it feels modern and built for brisk reading.
gen-fs-kalam-sora: Sora is precise and geometric, with no pressure swell where a curve turns the corner and its openings stay widely parted. Beside Kalam's cozy hand, it is best kept to brief text.
gen-fs-kalam-space-grotesk: Hand-drawn and cozy, Kalam pulls its lines tight, while Space Grotesk, a sans-serif, draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width. Space Grotesk's drafting-pen steadiness is the standout, made for quick reads.
gen-fs-karma-fs-supreme: Karma sets a refined serif voice, its rounded lowercase forms standing tall and each s open enough to see through. Supreme then runs crisp across a paragraph, a heavy-looking strip of text whose letters stay held open.
gen-fs-karma-general-sans: Karma leads with comfortable serif forms, its hairlines present but never razor thin. And General Sans, a sans-serif with rod-stock horizontals and verticals, gives that refinement a clean, professional footing.
